title: Kiritani Haruka — Dark Colors For A Mature Look〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Dark Colors For A Mature Look（4★）

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Very nice.
Your posture was already good, and you've managed to make it even better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have you to thank, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I'm genuinely impressed by how you're able to take my advice and get it right on the first try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
You saying that gives me quite a lot of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm still having trouble making the right expressions and knowing where to look...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. Just take it one step at a time while listening to our photographer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Can you try looking up a little for me this time?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's perfect!
As for your expression...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I thought this would be tough on Aoyagi since he's never really done anything like this before, but he's really doing his best to win the others those chocolates...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haruka, can you take a look at this for me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Kohane, Aoyagi, thank you for keeping an eye on our things. Here, I bought us some kebabs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we should be the ones thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here, Haruka, you can sit next to me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know, right? Airi told me about this place the other day when we were talking about grabbing a quick bite.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're stuffed full with vegetables and lean meat, so it makes them healthy, filling and guilt-free.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But these are packed so tightly that it's hard to keep it all together sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I feel like it's going to burst each time I bite into it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll need to be careful not to get any on my clothes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We still have our third photo left to take.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, how do you guys want it to look?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We've already spent a lot of time shooting, but neither of them seems all that tired.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means we should be able to make our last one really good.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What do you think it's saying?
Does it want something...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... But we probably shouldn't feed it, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but we can't give you any of our food.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh no...
It looks so sad. Now I want to feed it even more...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but you can't have any of this. I hope you understand...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I think it understands.
You seem rather witty...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's showing us its belly now.
Maybe it wants a rub?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since we can't give it any of our food...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, Aoyagi, wait...!
If you lean over like that, your kebab filling will fall.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, thank you. That was a close one...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unless... Were you feigning giving up in an attempt to get me to drop my kebab?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. If so, then it's a lot smarter than we thought.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hang on. Where have I seen this before?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it tilted its head.
Then how about I... Meeoow?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
S-S-Shizuku! Your tea!
It's gonna get all over your clothes...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They both seem cool and collected at first, but they can be a little clumsy.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also, neither seem to like giving up any commitments they've made.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Again, we're sorry.
No matter how many times you try, we can't give you any of our food.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm guessing we all feel bad about our furry friend here, so let's try to finish these as quickly as we can.
